$comment: Mobile, vehicle and house numbers. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.mobile.total.1: A number that totals 1 carries the Sun: confident, direct and good for leaders and business owners.
blocks.mobile.total.2: A number that totals 2 carries the Moon: friendly and caring, good for relationships and service.
blocks.mobile.total.3: A number that totals 3 carries Jupiter: respectable and wise, good for teachers, advisers and finance.
blocks.mobile.total.4: A number that totals 4 carries Rahu: practical but changeable, good for technical work if the birth numbers welcome it.
blocks.mobile.total.5: A number that totals 5 carries Mercury: lively and connected, one of the most popular totals for business and sales.
blocks.mobile.total.6: A number that totals 6 carries Venus: warm and attractive, good for creative, hospitality and family use.
blocks.mobile.total.7: A number that totals 7 carries Ketu: private and thoughtful, better for research than for selling.
blocks.mobile.total.8: A number that totals 8 carries Saturn: steady and serious, best when the birth numbers are friendly to Saturn.
blocks.mobile.total.9: A number that totals 9 carries Mars: energetic and bold, good for action, sport and leadership.
blocks.mobile.verdict.keep: Keep this number: it suits you well.
blocks.mobile.verdict.keep_with_notes: Keep this number, with the notes above in mind; a second number for key uses can help.
blocks.mobile.verdict.consider_second_number: This number does not suit you strongly. A second number is worth considering; if this one is used for business, weigh the cost of changing it carefully.
blocks.mobile.flow.smooth: Smooth pairs: the digits' elements support each other, so energy flows easily.
blocks.mobile.flow.neutral: Neutral pairs: the digits neither help nor hinder each other.
blocks.mobile.flow.clash: Clash pairs: the digits' elements work against each other, or the pair is on the popular avoid list.
blocks.mobile.flow.pause: Pauses: a zero breaks the flow; the digits on either side are not read together.
blocks.vehicle.total.1: A registration that totals 1 suits confident, independent travel and a vehicle used for work and leadership.
blocks.vehicle.total.2: A registration that totals 2 suits calm, family travel.
blocks.vehicle.total.3: A registration that totals 3 suits steady, respectable use and long journeys.
blocks.vehicle.total.4: A registration that totals 4 asks for careful maintenance and calm driving.
blocks.vehicle.total.5: A registration that totals 5 suits frequent travel, business and quick trips.
blocks.vehicle.total.6: A registration that totals 6 suits comfortable, family and leisure use.
blocks.vehicle.total.7: A registration that totals 7 suits thoughtful use; drive mindfully and keep the vehicle well serviced.
blocks.vehicle.total.8: A registration that totals 8 suits heavy, long-term use; patience on the road helps.
blocks.vehicle.total.9: A registration that totals 9 carries strong energy; it suits bold use, with care to avoid haste.
blocks.vehicle.verdict.keep_with_notes: This registration is workable, with the notes above in mind.
blocks.vehicle.verdict.consider_second_number: This registration does not suit you strongly; consider it when choosing your next vehicle.
blocks.house.number.1: House number 1: a home for independence, new starts and individual success.
blocks.house.number.2: House number 2: a home for partnership, peace and close family ties.
blocks.house.number.3: House number 3: a home for learning, growth and a sociable family.
blocks.house.number.4: House number 4: a home for hard work and stability; keep it orderly and well-maintained.
blocks.house.number.5: House number 5: a lively home with visitors, travel and change.
blocks.house.number.6: House number 6: a warm, beautiful home for family, love and comfort.
blocks.house.number.7: House number 7: a quiet home for study, reflection and rest.
blocks.house.number.8: House number 8: a home for building wealth and long-term security, slowly.
blocks.house.number.9: House number 9: an active home with energy; keep it calm with soft colours.
